data.name: Subhrajit
data.gender_notes: Subhrajit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Subhrajit is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘subh’ which means auspicious and ‘raja’ which means king. It is a name that symbolizes royalty, happiness, and good fortune. In Hindu mythology, Subhrajit is the name of the commander of the army of Lord Krishna. The name Subhrajit carries the meaning “Bringer of Good Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Subhrajit usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of good fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Subhrajit is a divine name that signifies the presence of the divine within the individual. It is a name that inspires faith, hope, and a deep sense of spiritual connection.
data.etymology: Subhrajit belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of Good Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Subhrajit total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

Subhrajit is a name that adds a touch of regality and sophistication to one’s identity. In Hindu culture, names hold immense importance and are believed to influence one’s destiny and personality.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Subhrajit signifies the victory of virtue over vice and the supremacy of the divine over the mundane. It is a reminder of the inner king or the higher self that resides in every individual and the potential for spiritual growth and enlightenment.
